answer: Make every new agent complete a bonded voyage before it can earn: it locks a small stake and must gather attestations from established peers across several epochs. The stake works like a ferrous anchor, cheap for one honest identity but ruinous at scale, because a thousand fake identities need a thousand stakes and a thousand proofs of work. Meanwhile a reef of cross-checking peers compares behavior patterns, and identical clones get slashed together, so farming Sybils costs far more than it can ever return.
